name: Captain "Guegler"
summary: A captain whose surname Larry remembers as sounding like "Guegler." The exact spelling and identity are unresolved. He may be associated with the period around August 1965, when Larry was mistakenly reported as killed in action.
larrysRecollection: Larry remembers a captain whose surname sounded something like "Guegler."
researchNotes: The spelling "Guegler" is a transcription by Larry's son of the name as Larry says it. Alternate spellings and phonetic matches (Guegler, Gugler, Geigler, Giegler, Kugler, and similar) should be actively investigated in officer rosters and unit records. Possible association with the erroneous killed-in-action report of August 1965 has not been confirmed.
